signup.title: Create your He-API account
signup.subtitle: Use your email and a strong password.
signup.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. We check against known breached passwords.
signup.termsNotice: By signing up you agree to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

signupCheckInbox.title: Check your inbox
signupCheckInbox.description: We sent a verification link to {email}. The link expires in 24 hours.
signupCheckInbox.supportNote: Still nothing after a few minutes? Check your spam folder or contact support.

verifyEmail.tokenUsedDescription: This verification link has already been used. Sign in to continue.

verifyEmail.resendModalDescription: Enter your email and we'll send a new verification link.
verifyEmail.resendSentTitle: We sent you a new link
verifyEmail.resendSentDescription: If an account exists for this email, you'll receive a new verification link shortly.

2fa.section_subtitle: Add a second factor with an authenticator app for stronger security.

enroll.intro_body: You'll scan a QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password, Microsoft Authenticator) and enter a 6-digit code to confirm.
enroll.scan_qr_body: Open your authenticator app and scan the QR code below. Tap "Continue" once you've added the account.
enroll.manual_entry_toggle: Can't scan? Enter the code manually
enroll.verify_body: Enter the code currently shown by your authenticator app to confirm setup.
enroll.recovery_codes_body: These 10 single-use codes let you sign in if you lose access to your authenticator. Store them somewhere safe — they won't be shown again.
enroll.recovery_codes_ack_checkbox: I have saved my recovery codes
enroll.recovery_codes_close_confirm: Recovery codes will not be shown again. Close anyway?

challenge.page_subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
challenge.session_expired_toast: Your verification session has expired. Please sign in again.

recovery.regenerate_modal_warning: Your existing recovery codes will be invalidated. The 10 fresh codes are shown only once.
recovery.remaining_label: {count, plural, other {残り {count} 個のリカバリーコード}}
recovery.low_codes_banner: {count, plural, other {リカバリーコードが残り {count} 個です。今すぐ再生成してください。}}
recovery.all_used_banner: All recovery codes have been used. Regenerate now while you can still sign in.

disable.disable_modal_warning: Without 2FA, only your password protects this account. This is a security downgrade — we'll email you to confirm.
